title: 第5章 至宝残躯化人形林镜身入洪荒劫第6章 鸿蒙灵根葫芦藤紫黄色水火葫芦
slug: 洪荒我怎么变成混沌至宝了
content_zh:
林镜就这么在混沌之中陷入了无尽的沉睡之中，不过在大道之力的滋养下恢复速度也加快了不少！
时间很快过去，三千魔神也成功孕育而生！
最终盘古大神耗尽全力战胜了他们，最终劈开混沌之后，也力竭而死了！
当洪荒世界孕育而出，宇宙间一片浩瀚无垠的景象展露在世人眼前。这片新兴的天地，充满了无限可能与蓬勃生机，吸引着各种能量与物质在此汇聚、碰撞、交融，进而催生出千千万万的生灵。
当盘古陨落后，他的伟大意志并未随风消逝，反而以一种更为神奇的形式传承了下来——他的元神分化为三位大能，即后来被誉为“三清”的道德天尊、灵宝天尊与元始天尊。
除了元神的分化之外，盘古大神的十二滴精血也发挥了至关重要的作用。它们如同十二枚蕴藏着无穷潜力的种子，在洪荒大地上落地生根，最终孕育出了十二位强大且独特的祖巫。
可惜从三千魔神诞生直到盘古大神开天辟地身死演化洪荒大地，林镜依旧在沉睡中……
当凶兽一族的首领大神神逆带领凶兽与洪荒万族开战之时，林镜依旧在沉睡中……
当祖龙、元凤、始麒麟三族争斗，争夺天地气运，进行天地大战之中，林镜依旧在沉睡中……
最终魔族罗喉和鸿钧老祖大战，鸿钧联合时辰道人乾坤道人扬眉老祖，四大魔神共抗魔祖罗喉，最终魔祖罗喉自爆身亡，时辰道人和乾坤道人身死，扬眉老祖重伤，鸿钧身合天道成圣！
然而，林镜依旧还在沉睡中……
毕竟作为洪荒第一件混沌至宝，在融合了无数岁月的大道之力和混沌之力所诞生的法宝，失去全部本源的伤害确实是十分恐怖的！
直到巫族崛起，不服天地，只认盘古父神，与妖族争夺天地，从此妖管天巫管地！
天地间的大劫之气终于稍微稳定了一点，林镜的本体混沌始源镜在这么多年大道的滋补下也修复完成了！
终于林镜的意识也随着复苏过来，虽然对于他而言，只不过感觉睡了一觉而已！
【叮！检测到宿主已经苏醒，触发选择任务！】
【任务一《抱大腿！苟住！》：继续选择待在大道空间之中，缓慢恢复本源！奖励：本源恢复0.01%！】
【任务二《以身入劫》：以混沌始源镜为大道根脚化为生灵，参与到洪荒大劫之中！奖励：本源恢复1%！】
刚刚苏醒的林镜就收到了来自系统的提示，这时他才发现，原来自从他昏迷之后，就被大道纳入大道空间之中！
稍微思索一下，林镜果断还是选择了任务二，毕竟不论是那个时期的洪荒都是机缘满地的！

而且之前睡着还行，既然现在已经苏醒过来了，一直待在大道空间之中也太无聊了……
随着林镜的决断落下，大道空间内也发生了变化！
只见原先占据中心位置的【混沌始源镜】，在一阵璀璨光芒的包裹下，缓缓淡出视线，仿佛融入了虚空中最深邃的秘密角落，仅留下淡淡的余晖证明它的曾经所在。
紧接着，林镜的意识脱离了大道空间的束缚，来到了洪荒世界之中！
他出现在一片遥远而偏僻的山脉之中，四周是连绵起伏的群山与茂密的森林，空气中弥漫着清新而又略带凉意的气息。
这里远离尘嚣，鲜有人迹，正适合进行一次彻底的蜕变。林镜环视四周，满意地点点头，决定就在这里开始自己的化形之旅。
【叮！化形所需能量不足，需要一会元时间进行积蓄！】
“卧槽！系统，你又坑我？你怎么不早说？”
【大道空间之中，本系统无法积攒能量……】
正当林镜心中略感郁闷，准备对系统来一番调侃时，一阵奇异的感觉突然涌遍全身，打断了他的思绪。
这股力量温和而不失强劲，就如同久违的老友一般，自然而然地融入了他的身体，与其灵魂深处产生了共鸣。林镜顿时愣住了，随即眼中闪过一抹惊讶与喜悦交织的神色。
【奖励已发放！本源恢复：1%！宿主即将陷入沉睡！】
content_en:
Lin Jing just fell into an endless sleep in the chaos, but his recovery speed was also accelerated a lot under the nourishment of the power of the avenue!
Time passed quickly, and three thousand demon gods were successfully conceived!
In the end, Pangu defeated them with all his strength, and after finally splitting the chaos, he died of exhaustion!
When the prehistoric world was born, a vast scene in the universe was revealed to the world. This emerging world is full of infinite possibilities and vigorous vitality, attracting all kinds of energy and matter to gather, collide, and blend here, thus giving birth to thousands of creatures.
When Pangu died, his great will did not disappear with the wind, but was passed down in a more miraculous form - his soul was divided into three powerful powers, namely the Daode Tianzun, Lingbao Tianzun and Yuanshi Tianzun who were later known as the "Three Pure Ones".
In addition to the differentiation of the soul, the twelve drops of blood essence of Pangu also played a vital role. They were like twelve seeds containing infinite potential, taking root in the ancient land, and eventually gave birth to twelve powerful and unique ancestral witches.
It's a pity that from the birth of the Three Thousand Demon Gods until the death of Pangu, the great god who created the world and transformed the prehistoric earth, Lin Jing was still sleeping...
When the leader of the ferocious beast clan, Shen Ni, led the ferocious beasts to fight against all the races in the wild, Lin Jing was still sleeping...
When the Zulong, Yuanfeng, and Shi Qilin clans were fighting for the destiny of heaven and earth, and in the midst of the great war between heaven and earth, Lin Jing was still sleeping...
In the end, Demon Luo Hou and Ancestor Hongjun fought. Hongjun united with the Taoist of Time, Qiankun Taoist and Ancestor Yangmei, and the four demons fought against the Ancestor Demon Luohou. In the end, the Demon Ancestor Luohou blew himself up and died, Taoist Shichen and Taoist Qiankun died, Ancestor Yangmei was seriously injured, and Hongjun merged with the Heavenly Dao and became a saint!
However, Lin Jing was still asleep...
After all, as the first chaos treasure in the world, a magic weapon born from the fusion of the power of the avenue and the power of chaos for countless years, the damage of losing all its origins is indeed very terrifying!
Until the rise of the Wu Clan, they were not convinced by heaven and earth, and only recognized Father God Pangu, and competed with the demon clan for heaven and earth. From then on, the demons ruled the sky and the witches ruled the earth!
The aura of great calamity between heaven and earth has finally stabilized a little, and Lin Jing's body, the Origin Mirror of Chaos, has been repaired under the nourishment of so many years of great avenues!
Finally, Lin Jing's consciousness came back to life, although to him, it just felt like he had slept!
【bite! It is detected that the host has awakened, triggering the selection task! 】
[Task 1 "Hold the Thigh!" Stay alive! 》: Continue to choose to stay in the avenue space and slowly restore your origin! Reward: 0.01% source recovery! 】
[Mission 2: Entering into the Tribulation: Using the Mirror of the Origin of Chaos as the root of the avenue, become a living being and participate in the great catastrophe! Reward: 1% source recovery! 】
Lin Jing, who had just woken up, received a prompt from the system. Only then did he realize that since he was unconscious, he had been included in the space of the avenue!
After thinking for a while, Lin Jing decided to choose task two. After all, no matter what the prehistoric period was, opportunities were everywhere!
And it was okay to fall asleep before, but now that I have woken up, it is too boring to stay in the avenue space all the time...
As Lin Jing made his decision, changes occurred in the avenue space!
The [Chaos Origin Mirror] that originally occupied the central position slowly faded out of sight under a burst of bright light, as if it had merged into the deepest secret corner of the void, leaving only a faint afterglow to prove its former location.
Immediately afterwards, Lin Jing's consciousness broke away from the constraints of the avenue space and came to the prehistoric world!
He appeared in a remote and remote mountain range, surrounded by rolling mountains and dense forests. The air was filled with a fresh and slightly cool atmosphere.
This place is far away from the hustle and bustle and rarely visited, which is perfect for a complete transformation. Lin Jing looked around, satisfiedNodding, he decided to start his transformation journey here.
【bite! The energy required to transform is insufficient, and it will take a while to save up! 】
"Fuck! System, are you cheating me again? Why didn't you tell me earlier?"
[In the avenue space, this system cannot accumulate energy...]
Just when Lin Jing felt a little depressed and was about to make fun of the system, a strange feeling suddenly surged through his body, interrupting his thoughts.
This force was gentle yet powerful, like a long-lost old friend, it naturally integrated into his body and resonated with the depths of his soul. Lin Jing was stunned for a moment, and then a look of surprise and joy flashed in his eyes.
[Rewards have been distributed! Origin recovery: 1%! The host is about to fall into deep sleep! 】
